REED_POWER_SCORCH.title: Scorch
REED_POWER_SCORCH.description: At end of turn, deal 1 damage per stack and reduce by 1.
REED_POWER_SCORCH_COUNTER.title: Scorch
REED_POWER_SCORCH_COUNTER.description: Accumulated Scorch stacks. Can be consumed by other cards to trigger effects.
REED_POWER_ASH.title: Ash
REED_POWER_ASH.description: Accumulated Ash stacks, can be consumed by cards. In Original Form, gain 1 Block per stack at the start of each turn; no Block while in [blue]Flame Shadow Form[/blue].
REED_POWER_FLAME_SHADOW_FORM.title: Flame Shadow Form
REED_POWER_FLAME_SHADOW_FORM.description: Flame Shadow Form: At the end of each turn, deal damage to ALL enemies equal to their [red]Scorch[/red] stacks. [blue]Ash[/blue] grants no Block in this form.
REED_POWER_CALAMITY_BREATH.title: Calamity Breath
REED_POWER_CALAMITY_BREATH.description: At the start of each turn, apply {Amount} [red]Vulnerable[/red] to all enemies with [red]Scorch[/red].
REED_POWER_EMBER_SPREAD.title: Ember Spread
REED_POWER_EMBER_SPREAD.description: When an enemy dies, spread its [red]Scorch[/red] stacks to other alive enemies.
REED_POWER_EVERFLAME_POWER.title: Everflame
REED_POWER_EVERFLAME_POWER.description: At the end of each turn, if any enemy has [red]Scorch[/red], gain {Amount} [blue]Ash[/blue].
REED_POWER_UNITED_FRONT_POWER.title: United Front
REED_POWER_UNITED_FRONT_POWER.descriptio: At the start of each turn, apply [red]Scorch[/red] to ALL enemies equal to ally count x {Amount}.
REED_POWER_DRAGONS_LEGACY_POWER.title: Dragon's Legacy
REED_POWER_DRAGONS_LEGACY_POWER.descript: At the start of each turn, gain {Amount} [gold]Strength[/gold] and apply {Amount} [red]Scorch[/red] to ALL enemies.
REED_POWER_ASH_RECOVERY_POWER.title: Ash Recovery
REED_POWER_ASH_RECOVERY_POWER.descriptio: Whenever you Exhaust a card, heal {Amount} HP.
REED_POWER_SCORCH_IMMUNITY.title: Scorch Immunity
REED_POWER_ETERNAL_EMBER_POWER.title: Eternal Ember
REED_POWER_ETERNAL_EMBER_POWER.descripti: At the start of each turn, apply 3 [red]Scorch[/red] to ALL enemies and gain Block equal to total [red]Scorch[/red] on all enemies.
REED_POWER_SPELL_VULNERABLE.title: Spell Vulnerable
REED_POWER_ASH_EMBRACE_POWER.title: Ashen Embrace
REED_POWER_ASH_EMBRACE_POWER.description: At the start of each turn, gain Block equal to [blue]Ash[/blue] stacks x {Amount}.
REED_POWER_EMBER_AFTERGLOW_POWER.title: Ember Afterglow
REED_POWER_EMBER_AFTERGLOW_POWER.descrip: Whenever a card is Exhausted, draw 1 card (max {Amount} per turn).
REED_POWER_DRAGONS_MAJESTY_POWER.title: Dragonborn Majesty
REED_POWER_DRAGONS_MAJESTY_POWER.descrip: At the start of each turn, apply {Amount} [red]Weak[/red] to every enemy with [red]Scorch[/red].
REED_POWER_EVERBURNING_POWER.title: Everburning
REED_POWER_EVERBURNING_POWER.description: Scorch on this enemy no longer decays each turn (damage still applies).
REED_POWER_DRAGON_DOMINANCE_POWER.title: Dragon Dominance
REED_POWER_DRAGON_DOMINANCE_POWER.descri: At the start of each turn, if ALL enemies have [red]Scorch[/red], gain {Amount} [gold]Strength[/gold].
REED_POWER_WINDBLAZE_POWER.title: Windblaze
REED_POWER_WINDBLAZE_POWER.description: At the end of each of your turns, ALL enemies gain {Amount} [red]Scorch[/red].
REED_POWER_INFERNAL_PACT_POWER.title: Infernal Pact
